{
  "id": "mesh_refine",
  "family": "mesh_refine",
  "genre": "3d",
  "label": "UltraShape Mesh Refine",
  "description": "Image-guided coarse-mesh refinement (UltraShape 1.0 DiT) \u2014 carves sharp limb separation + hard-surface edges into blobby TRELLIS output using the SAME guide image the mesh was generated from. The pre-rig cleanup step: run BEFORE SOMAX so proximity-based weight transfer can't glue arm vertices to torso bones.",
  "source": {
    "type": ""
  },
  "defaults": {
    "box_v": 1.0,
    "mc_level": 0.0,
    "normalize_scale": 0.99,
    "num_latents": 32768,
    "num_sharp_points": 204800,
    "num_uniform_points": 204800,
    "preset": "standard",
    "dtype": "bfloat16",
    "low_vram": false,
    "steps": 50,
    "guidance_scale": 5.0,
    "octree_resolution": 384,
    "num_chunks": 8000,
    "remove_bg": false,
    "seed": 42,
    "file_format": "glb",
    "filename_prefix": "ultrashape_refined"
  },
  "engine": "",
  "form": "form_3d_mesh_refine",
  "has_inference": false,
  "has_rubric": false
}
